opening.argument: The presentation promotes an automated system for copying selected Solana meme-coin wallets and directs viewers toward related trading services. That solicitation is paired with unusually large reported returns: the speaker says a wallet made “over a 1000 Solana in just February,” while the displayed trading page shows a 7D Realized PnL of +201.2% and +12.78 SOL. The speaker also says viewers can copy that trader “with a bigger stack,” reinforcing a high-return appeal. Although the presentation mentions risk and advises using only affordable-to-lose funds, those warnings do not remove its promotion of copy trading, automated settings, and related services. The returns are not established as typical, guaranteed, independently verified, or actually obtained by viewers.
